title: From Augmentation to Synthetic Evidence: Evaluating Generated Chest Radiographs at Dataset Intake
abstract: arXiv:2610.29152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A generated chest radiograph can be useful as declared augmentation, but the same image becomes unsupported evidence when submitted as the record of a real examination. We study this problem by separating three questions: whether an image passes an automated quality check, whether an origin classifier flags it as generated, and whether a trusted record supports the claimed acquisition. In our experiments, Qwen selects up to 20 images from pools of 1,000 existing Cheff-identified or SynthCheX candidates. A receiver evaluates quality with MedGemma and predicted origin with a classifier on frozen DINOv3 features. Quality-based selection raises quality passes from 12 to 19 of 20 for Cheff-identified images and from 8 to 17 for SynthCheX. translated_title: 从数据增强到合成证据：在数据集入口处评估生成的胸部X光片
translated_abstract: 生成的胸部X光片作为明示的数据增强可能是有用的，但当同一张图像被提交作为真实检查的记录时，它就变成了缺乏依据的证据。我们通过区分三个问题来研究这一问题：图像是否通过自动化质量检查、来源分类器是否将其标记为生成图像，以及可信记录是否支持所声称的采集过程。在我们的实验中，Qwen从1,000张现有的Cheff识别或SynthCheX候选图像池中最多选择20张图像。接收方使用MedGemma评估图像质量，并使用基于冻结DINOv3特征的分类器预测图像来源。基于质量的选择使Cheff识别图像的质量通过率从20张中的12张提高到19张，SynthCheX图像从8张提高到17张。我们没有发现任何证据表明选择能够改善同时通过两项检查的情况：没有选中的Cheff识别图像能同时通过两项检查，而均匀选择、质量选择和质量约束的替代选择分别产生2张、1张和……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出在数据集入口处对生成的胸部X光片进行质量检查、来源分类和记录验证的三重评估，发现基于质量的选择虽能显著提高质量通过率，但无法使生成图像同时通过质量与来源双重检查。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a triple evaluation framework at dataset intake—quality check, origin classification, and record verification—for generated chest radiographs, finding that while quality-based selection significantly improves quality pass rates, no generated image can simultaneously pass both the quality and origin checks.
